name: Jesus Coming Back
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that Jesus will return visibly and unmistakably, like lightning shining from east to west, and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him. His coming is certain but the exact day and hour are known only by the Father. Jesus promises to come again to receive His followers to be with Him, affirming His eternal nature as the Alpha and Omega. At His return, He will bring rewards according to each person's deeds, emphasizing both His justice and mercy.
